Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two distinct proteomics approaches: a targeted approach (PRM/t-SIM) for 15 specific proteins and a shotgun approach for general protein identification. The shotgun data deposited in PRIDE (PXD008536) used DDA-like acquisition (Top 10 most intense ions) and LFQ quantification. Because both targeted and DDA modes are described, acquisition_type is set to Unknown to avoid oversimplification, though the PRIDE data specifically follows a DDA-LFQ pattern.
